propositions: After Jira create returns a key, the known key must be persisted on the still-pending RP-02 entry via record_pending_key + save BEFORE attaching the canonical rebar-id label to ensure deterministic recovery if a crash occurs in the create-to-label window.

The canonical rebar-id label must be attempted before the optional entity property, and both must complete before local confirmation via bind_confirm; any failure after create must preserve the known key and remote issue without deletion.
Property persistence failures (unsupported or permission denied) must remain visible and cannot erase a successfully attached label or the durable remote identity floor.
All post-create failures must report the known key and retain recovery evidence through keyed-pending binding state, with no scenario resulting in remote issue deletion.
Known key and confirmation must persist exclusively through the RP-02 BindingStore facade, establishing a single identity owner for local durable state.
